title: Pokemon TCG Silver Tempest Dragonite 131/195 Holo Card
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The product is a Pokémon TCG card featuring the Dragonite character from the Sword & Shield - Silver Tempest set. This specific card has a Silver rarity, a Holo finish, and is numbered 131 out of 195 in the set. Manufactured by Nintendo, this collectible card is a valuable addition to any Pokémon TCG collection for fans of Dragonite and the Silver Tempest series.
